paragraphs: International gold is at $4,122 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.05 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,727/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (6 headlines), Inflation (5 headlines), The US dollar (1 headline), Geopolitics and safe-haven buying (1 headline).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Prices Fall for Third Session as Oil-Driven Inflation Concerns Shift Focus to Fed Rates (Yahoo Finance); Gold Price Forecast: High Treasury Yields Put $4,000 Support in Focus (FXEmpire).

Inflation. Gold is held as an inflation hedge, though hot inflation can also mean higher rates, which cuts the other way. In the news: Gold Prices Fall for Third Session as Oil-Driven Inflation Concerns Shift Focus to Fed Rates (Yahoo Finance); Gold prices declined amid cautious anticipation of the Federal Reserve meeting and US inflation data (صوت الإمارات).

The US dollar. Gold is priced in dollars: a stronger dollar usually pushes it down, a weaker one lifts it. In the news: October 20 Financial Morning Brief: Gold prices pressured by stronger dollar; markets await policy guidance. Russian diesel has not yet entered the market, while oil prices hit a one-month high. (富途牛牛).
